I had clicking sounds in the steering wheel when turning it back and forth in a certain position, even with a few centimeters of amplitude. I'd been to two other repair shops and an authorized Mitsubishi dealership with this problem.
At the first, they said the steering rack needed replacing. I had my doubts; I could clearly hear clicking sounds in the steering wheel.
At the second, I asked for a steering system diagnostic, and they said the steering rack was fine, but I needed to inspect the steering wheel. They couldn't do it themselves, so they recommended I take it to a dealership.
So I went to an authorized Mitsubishi dealership for a precise diagnostic. They checked the steering wheel, lubricated it with silica spray, and said it was ready. I paid for the work and drove away happily. Ten minutes later, the clicking returned. I went back, they looked, then started telling me it was normal and that other cars had the same problem. Then they said if I wanted to eliminate the clicking, I needed to replace the steering rack, along with a list of 5-6 parts.
I declined and found a nearby repair shop called CARVIA GARAGE online. Everything was professional and pleasant to deal with. They figured out the problem, ran diagnostics, and had to replace the steering column, the mechanism under the steering wheel. The steering rack is fine! Everything works as it should now! They didn't have to randomly replace parts that would still work, as other repair shops suggested, at my expense.
I highly recommend them! I'll definitely be back if I need any repairs on my car.
